fleetApplicationStatusScreen.actionRequiredBody: The rest of the fleet is unaffected and stays in review. Fix what is flagged below and resubmit — approved vehicles keep their verdict.
fleetApplicationStatusScreen.approvedBody: The company account is active and every approved vehicle can be dispatched. Assign new vehicles or drivers any time from the dispatch dashboard.
fleetApplicationStatusScreen.companyDetailsAndVehicles: Company details and {count, plural, one {# vehicle need} other {# vehicles need}} correcting
fleetApplicationStatusScreen.flaggedVehiclesCannotBeDispatchedContact: Flagged vehicles cannot be dispatched. Contact support to have one re-reviewed.
fleetApplicationStatusScreen.pendingBody: Our team is checking the company registration, then each vehicle and its driver. Vehicles are cleared individually — you can start dispatching as soon as the company is approved and at least one vehicle passes.
fleetApplicationStatusScreen.recheckedBeforeExpiry: Licences and cooling-unit records are re-checked 30 days before expiry.
fleetApplicationStatusScreen.resubmitFailed: We couldn't resubmit your application. Please try again.
fleetApplicationStatusScreen.saveCorrectedDetails: Save the corrected details to send them back for review.
fleetApplicationStatusScreen.typicalReviewTime: Typical review time is 24–48 hours for a fleet this size.
fleetApplicationStatusScreen.vehicleUpdated: Vehicle updated. Resubmit when every flagged item is fixed.
fleetApplicationStatusScreen.vehiclesNeedCorrecting: {count, plural, one {# vehicle needs} other {# vehicles need}} correcting
